stem.text: Immune response to a vaccination against a virus can be assessed by making three measurements:

items: the concentration of anti-virus antibody in the blood
the time taken to increase the antibody concentration significantly after a booster vaccination
the number of virus-specific lymphocytes per $\text{cm}^{3}$ blood.

stem.text: What describes the immunity of an individual when the values of 1, 2 and 3 are all low ten years after vaccination?

A.text: active immunity due to the presence of memory cells

B.text: low immunity due to the absence of antibodies

C.text: low immunity due to the absence of memory cells

D.text: passive immunity due to the presence of antibodies
